storyline_causality_quote: In response, a Meta executive admitted that starting a test in which contract workers made calls without properly telling people was a mistake.
entertainment_quote: People often worry that an AI phone call will produce a strange answer.
comprehension_quote: So people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.
thinness_quote: These workers did more than make the conversation smooth: the user’s sensitive information might be shared with contract workers at a call center.
